description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractService implementing the Service interface, managing service lifecycle states (init, start, stop), logging, and listener notifications within the org.apache.hive.service package.

classes.name: AbstractService
classes.description: An abstract class providing lifecycle management (init, start, stop) for services, with state tracking, logging, and listener notification capabilities.

methods.name: getServiceState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the service.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the service with a HiveConf configuration, changing state to INITED.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the service, recording start time and changing state to STARTED.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the service if it is in STARTED state, changing state to STOPPED.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a listener for service state changes.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a listener for service state changes.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service.

methods.name: getHiveConf
methods.description: Returns the HiveConf configuration associated with the service.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the service was started.
